questions.q: What did this Intermediate capstone add that the Beginner capstone didn't have?
options: A transforming Glue ETL job, an actual modeled Redshift warehouse, a schedule, two stakeholders, and two realistic production bugs
Nothing meaningfully different; it repeats the Beginner project exactly
A completely different fictional company and dataset
Only a change in which AWS region the resources live in
questions.explain: Beginner was raw CSVs, a crawler, and ad hoc Athena queries; Intermediate added a real transforming ETL job, a warehouse, scheduling, and two full bug arcs.

questions.q: Why does this course treat the two bug chapters (Lessons 11-13 and 14-15) as core project skill, not a detour?
options: IAM gaps and silent schema-drift are two of the most common real tickets a data engineer gets, and diagnosing them calmly with a reproduce-first discipline is itself the skill
Bugs were included only for novelty and don't reflect real data engineering work
The bug chapters are optional and can be skipped without losing anything
Diagnosing production issues has nothing to do with being a data engineer
questions.explain: The lesson frames both diagnose-and-fix arcs as the second half of the real project, not a detour from it.

questions.q: What specifically does the Advanced capstone (aws-capstone) add on top of this pipeline?
options: Step Functions orchestration, CloudWatch monitoring and alerting, CI/CD for the Glue scripts, IAM hardening, and disaster recovery
A brand-new fictional company and an entirely different dataset
Nothing at all; it is identical in scope to this course
A switch from Redshift to a different, unrelated warehouse product
questions.explain: The Advanced tier takes the same pipeline further with orchestration, monitoring, CI/CD, IAM hardening, and DR.

questions.q: How does this lesson frame the relationship between this course and the Advanced capstone?
options: As the next, harder version of the exact same problem, built on the exact same pipeline — not a new scenario to learn from scratch
As a completely unrelated course with no shared resources
As a simpler, easier follow-up course meant for review only
As a course that replaces and discards everything built here
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly frames the Advanced capstone as continuity, not a fresh start — same raw zone, same ETL job, same warehouse, same reports.

questions.q: What does the Lesson 16 self-assessment lab specifically ask you to identify?
options: The single hardest lesson in this chapter and the specific concept that took the most re-reading, useful for deciding what to review before the Advanced capstone
A list of every AWS service used anywhere in the course
The exact dollar total of Northfield's company-wide revenue
A ranking of all 16 lessons from easiest to hardest
questions.explain: The lab asks for a specific, honest reflection on the hardest concept, not a generic list or ranking.
